opening.text: The coronation dance has stopped on a circle of smoked glass. Beneath your boots the chasm breathes white steam through cracks, and {C02} stands at the vent wheel, turning it open. His crews rivet the old archive door shut, hammers ringing over banners falling into the white. {C03} holds the old registry at the steam line. {C01}'s brass key hangs cold at his wrist, and he mutters that one name remains to be struck. Your black signet fogs against your palm. {C03} says it opens only for the dead.

glass_floored_ballroom.text: {C03}'s fingers tighten on the registry. The page does not slip. The old ink holds against the steam, darkening at the edges, and the name stays under her hand.
{C03}'s fingers loosen. The page slips under her hand. The name runs into grey water, and she lets it go.
{C01}'s hand stays open around the brass key. The chain rests easy at his wrist, as if the house has not noticed him.
{C01}'s hand has closed into a fist. The brass key digs into his palm, and the chain pulls tight as if the house has swallowed him.
{C02}'s hand stays on the vent wheel. The steam breathes under his control, and the archive door takes another rivet without protest.
{C02}'s hand has lifted away from the vent wheel. The pressure builds behind the rivets, and his jaw tightens against the noise.
The glass floor is a wet mirror over the chasm, cracked and steaming. The old banners fall past the gas lamps, darkening as they drop into the white.

interactions.text: You say the name over the steam. The page darkens under the sound. {C03}'s hand steadies on the wet leather, and the old ink stops running.
You turn the page into the steam. The letters run into grey water, and the name loses its edge before it can catch on the room.
interactions.detail_label: let the steam blur the name

interactions.text: {C03} does not move. The registry stays wet with steam between her hands, and the ballroom waits under the sound of the rivets.
{C01} takes the registry against his chest. He bows once, keeps the brass key close, and lets the chain hang where the house can see it.
You draw the registry free. The chain snaps taut at his wrist, and he stumbles back into the wet circle without looking up.
{C01} waits with the registry in his hands. The key hangs still, and neither of you moves the old name any closer to the steam.
{C02} lowers the vent a fraction and leaves the archive door sealed. The steam thins, and his crews resume their riveting without breaking rhythm.
{C02} turns the wheel hard. The pressure builds behind the rivets, and his jaw tightens as the room fills with a lower, hotter breath.
The brass is hot under your palm. {C02} does not move the wheel, and the vent keeps breathing on the rivets.
interactions.detail_label: rest your hand on the wheel

interactions.text: You set a rivet beside the old lock. The door groans once, and {C02} nods to you as if you have just signed something you will not read later.
You pass a tin cup of hot water to a crewman. The steam takes it at once, and neither of you drinks more than a mouthful before the cold comes back.
interactions.detail_label: share hot water from the copper cup

interactions.text: A black-and-gold banner slips from your hands and falls past the gas lamps. It darkens as it drops, and the white steam closes over it without a sound.
interactions.detail_label: drop a banner into the chasm

interactions.text: {C03} takes the page to the steam line. Where the old ink meets the steam, the city's next keeping shows itself in half-erased letters.
The key swings once and stills. The dance has stopped in a wet circle, and the room shows the old house being carried, with the engine waiting below.
interactions.detail_label: let the key hang on its chain

interactions.text: You lay the cold chain over the crack while {C01} carries the registry into the steam. {C02} says the old house will be carried; {C03} says the engine will be fed. The glass holds, barely.
interactions.detail_label: hold the chain across the cracked glass

interactions.text: {C02}'s crews open the steam door. The descent stair breathes out of the dark, and you step past the sealed archive into the lower city's noise.

events.text: The last rivet goes into the archive door, and the old room on the other side goes dark.

nudges.text: {C03}'s voice carries over the steam, flat and close: 'The page is still wet. It will not wait much longer.'

recap.text: You stood in the cracked ballroom while {C02} opened the steam vent and his crews riveted the archive door shut. {C03} pressed the old registry against the steam, {C01} caught it with his brass key, and your black signet fogged as the page began to run.

opening.text: The transition corridor has tilted past the point where standing is a choice. Floor is wall, the shadows run along the ceiling, and the last old banners are carried sideways into the dark by a steam tide that has no shore. {C03} is here, half-spent, her cold hand open in the wet air. {C01} follows on the title chain, his boots slipping on the seam, the chain pulling at his wrist like a rusted crown. Ahead the seam door groans toward broken gravity, and the wet iron asks for a weight it will not give back.

leaning_passage.text: {C01}'s wrist stays steady on the title chain, and the registry page in your hand stays dry enough to read. The chain holds under the tilt, its link biting into his sleeve, the wet seam giving no more than a black ring of oil. The old name on the page keeps its edge while the steam tide waits for a slip.

The title chain has burned a red line through {C01}'s sleeve, and the name on the registry blurs in the steam like a word rubbed out. He is still following, but the seam drags at his boots and the link pulls at his wrist. The wet seam shines under the passage lamp, and the steam tide moves a little closer to his sleeve.

The leaning passage is tilted past the point where the floor is a floor. The shadows run on the ceiling, the black rail is slick with oil, and the steam tide carries the old banners sideways into the dark. Copper and ozone hang in the bend, and the light from the passage lamp curves around a corner you cannot see. The seam ahead is not a place to stand; it is a road laid on the wall.

seam_landing.text: {C03}'s handprint is solid on the seam door, and her voice comes through the steam clear enough to keep the old names from smearing. The iron holds under her fingers, the wet edge of the door standing straight, the registry in your hand keeping its letters separate. The tide presses at the seam, but the door does not give.

{C03}'s handprint is fading into the steam, and the seam door has taken the shape of her fingers and let them go. Her outline thins where the tide passes over it, the wet iron keeping only a cold smear of her grip. The old names on the registry begin to blur, one letter at a time, under the tide that has no bottom.

The corridor has sealed behind you. The seam door shows what you left in the broken gravity: {C01}'s chain hangs where he braced, a rusted weight on the wet iron, and {C03}'s handprint is still wet where the steam tried to spend her. The tide has taken the banners, the rail, and the last clear edge of the passage, leaving only the door's cold print.

The seam landing is a mouth of wet iron. The tide channel runs along the floor, the oil slick shines under the passage lamp, and the seam door stands open into the broken gravity. Copper and ozone hang in the air, the black rail bends around the corner, and the machinery beyond breathes with a weather that has no sky. The open door does not promise a road; it only shows the wall you must now walk.

interactions.text: {C01} braces against the wall and takes the weight of the chain. The registry stays dry under your hand, and his boots find the wet seam without slipping. His knuckles go white on the link, and the chain settles into him like a rusted crown settling on the neck.

You haul on the chain and {C01} is dragged toward the steam tide. His boots skid, the name on the registry blurs at the edge of the light, and the chain leaves a red line burning through his sleeve. The seam takes another pull of him, and the wet iron keeps what it is given.

{C01} waits where the chain slackens. The steam does not decide for him, and the corridor keeps its tilt, asking for the next weight. The wet rail shines under the passage lamp, and the seam door groans once in the dark.
{C03}'s cold fingers lock on the seam door. The iron holds just long enough to keep her voice clear for one old name. Then the steam takes her fingertips first, and the door begins to give.

You step back and the tide passes. The seam door swings wide, and {C03}'s outline thins in the wet water, spending her shape on the crossing. The tide does not ask whether she is finished; it only moves on.
interactions.detail_label: step back and let the tide pass

interactions.text: {C03} does not answer. The seam door groans, and the steam tide moves a little closer to her hand. The wet iron waits, and the old names on the registry keep their edges for one more breath.

You wedge the passage lamp into a crack in the wet iron. The flame stands sideways, throwing the oil stain into a black sun, and the shadows on the ceiling run a little less like animals. The light bends around the corner, and the broken gravity shows itself a little more plainly.

You pull the banner remnant from the steam. It is heavy with water, and the old name is almost gone. The silk still tries to stand like a flag against the tilt, but the tide has already spent most of what it was.

The tilt gauge's needle has gone off the scale. The glass is fogged with steam, and the little brass man inside is lying on his ceiling, as if the earth has finally shown him the way home. The gauge does not correct itself; it only keeps the wrong reading.

{C02}'s steam crews come up through the tide channel with iron hooks. You let them grip you, and the ceiling becomes the road as they haul you into the line. {C03}'s voice thins behind you like a name being spent, and the broken gravity takes you over its edge.
interactions.detail_label: let the steam crews pull you along the ceiling

interactions.text: {C03}'s cold hand closes around yours in the steam and pulls you through the broken gravity. Her shape spends itself on the crossing, and the old registry comes out wet with steam, its names blurred like water on glass. The seam door swings shut behind you, and the corridor seals with a sound like a valve closing on a wound.

events.text: The steam tide takes the first of the old city's banners, and the banner remnant on the rail goes white as it is spent. Its name dissolves into the wet air, and the rail keeps only a black smear where the silk used to hang.

nudges.text: {C03}'s voice comes through the steam, thin as a signet: 'The registry is wet. It is waiting for a name.'
{C01}'s chain creaks where he stands. 'The door will not hold forever.'

recap.text: The transition corridor tilted until the floor became a wall, and the steam tide carried the last old banners sideways into the dark. {C03}'s cold hand closed around yours and pulled you through the broken gravity, spending her shape until the old registry was wet and its names blurred, while {C01} followed on the title's chain and the corridor sealed behind you.

opening.text: The engine gates have opened far enough for the steam tide to lick under the lower doors, and the core's turn is louder than it was a minute ago. {C02} stands in the gate antechamber with the engine key in his palm and the new registry open on the lectern, his crews hooked to the gates behind him. The old seal plate is still warm where it was broken, and the air tastes of iron and wet wool. Behind the lower doors the gear throat opens, and the roar under the floor makes the registry pages tremble. You stand between the gates and the key while the core turns harder against the earth.

gate_antechamber.text: {C02} stands at the registry lectern with the new registry open, one hand resting on the engine key, as if the crews' names are waiting to be made his.
{C02} grips the engine key with both hands at the crew bench, knuckles white, and will not meet the registry lectern.
The new registry lies open on the lectern, blank pages steaming in the gate's heat.

lower_doors.text: The chain rail hangs slack where a hook has been turned, as if someone has already chosen which gate to trust.
The chain rail is kinked and black with oil, and the tide lock's wheel is smeared with fresh handprints.
Steam beads on the seal plate and drips through the archive mouth like a slow, patient tongue.

core_threshold.text: The core gauge's needle trembles on a mark someone has scratched with a stylus, an old name half worn away beneath the paint.
The core gauge is clouded with condensation, and the gear plate's old tally is filed out, leaving only a blind scar.
The gear throat opens into the core's turn, a low roar behind the gate channels that makes the air taste of iron.

interactions.text: {C02} does not smile, but his thumb moves along the key's edge as if the metal had been waiting for the word. He writes the crews' names into the new registry, one by one, and steps back from the lectern. The key stays in his hand, red-hot with the heat of their palms.
You take the key from {C02}'s palm. The crews' grip loosens, and the lower doors shudder a hand's width wider. The metal bites your fingers red, and the old order's last seal is already broken.

{C02} pauses, the key still in his hand, and looks at the registry as if it were a wound. The crews keep straining against the gates, their hooks creaking in the steam. The core's turn grows louder behind the lower doors.
interactions.detail_label: "Not yet. Let the names go first."

interactions.text: You fit a hook into the nearest gate channel and the crew takes the strain through it. For a moment the lower doors stop groaning, and the steam tide pulls back an inch. The metal is slick with oil and too warm to hold for long.

You wipe condensation from the core gauge and the needle is already in the red, trembling against a mark no one has painted over. The glass fogs again almost at once, as if the core is breathing through it.
{C02} reads the line without looking up. "The old names were merely ballast," he says. "The new names are crew." The ink on the page is still wet enough to smear.
interactions.detail_label: "What does the registry say about the old names?"

interactions.text: The token is warm and stamped with the engine's old seal, its edge worn smooth by thumbs that are no longer at the gates. {C02} does not stop you, which is its own comment.

You pass through the lower doors as the steam tide closes behind you. The core threshold opens ahead, and the gear throat swallows the sound of the gates. {C02}'s voice follows you: "The key decides what the core remembers."

events.text: A crewman's hook snaps against the gate channel, and the lower doors groan a hand's width wider under the steam tide.

nudges.text: The core's turn rises behind the steam, and {C02}'s voice carries from the gates: "The key will not wait. The names are ready."

recap.text: You stood at the engine gates while {C02} held the engine key and the new registry, and the crews strained at the gates as the core's turn grew louder and the steam tide rose. Their names went into the new registry, the key came hot with the heat of their palms, and the old order's last seal broke before the core turned.

opening.text: The gear-throne stands stopped at the bottom of the world, and the city below shows as a ragged wound in the rock. {C01} waits at the chain well, his hands white on the links. {C02} stands at the strike plate. Beyond the door, {C03} is gone grey in the steam. The black aperture waits around the throne like a held eye.

gear_throne.text: The gear-throne waits under {C02}'s open hand, the brass key loose in his grip. His face is arranged for a return he has not made.
The gear-throne is silent under your grip, the key cold and too small. The crews' names in the new registry stay wet under the lamp.
The gear-throne stands stopped in the pit, its teeth full of oil and old names. The chain well gapes beneath it, and the black aperture breathes faintly around the rim.

registry_alcove.text: The old registry lies open on the signing stone. The last name waits like a wound.
The registry shelf is bowed under name stacks, the signing stone slick with ink and steam. The ink well holds a black that is not quite ink.

steam_door.text: The brass key holds the steam door open. The white steam pours out like a name being read.
The steam door is a wall of white, the old archive hissing behind it. The burn rail is black with scorch, and the gauge points past red into a color the glass should not show.

crew_gallery.text: The crew lanterns drip oil onto the gallery floor, and the hold bar is slick where the crews gripped it. The engine lever waits at the wall, cold enough to burn.

interactions.text: You drag the oil spout across the strike plate. The metal shines, then the oil settles into a name no one spoke. The name does not clear.
The drum grinds under your palm. A column of old names slides past, each damp with heat. Yours is among them, already crossed out, and the drum will not stop on it.
You press the brass key into {C01}'s hand. He closes his fingers around it without looking, and the key is gone under his knuckles.
The steam door parts, white and merciless. The old archive breathes out of the dark, and the heat takes the front of your coat and does not let go.
interactions.detail_label: out the steam door, into the old archive

events.text: The last breath of silence breaks. The gear-throne starts again, and the black aperture opens around it, a hole of turning gears swallowing the light.

nudges.text: {C03}'s voice comes out of the steam, wet and patient: 'The name is still waiting.'

recap.text: The gear-throne stopped, showing the city as a wound, then started, and gears opened a black hole around it. {C01} held the chain, {C02} was pulled by his key, {C03} recited names from the steam; the old registry waited, the brass key held the steam door open, {C01} died, and the signet drew chain around your neck.

opening.text: The gear-throne has finished its turning, and you stand before it while the chain well holds the rusted chain, still warm from the core. White steam pours out of the old archive, and the name drum grinds black filings into the floor. The filings fall in a black rain, and the floor takes them. {C02} stands in the crew gallery with the engine key in his hand. {C01} waits at the strike plate, his jaw set. {C03} is half-drowned in the steam door, and the old names press against the steam like wet paper.

gear_throne.text: {C01} stands at the strike plate with the chain over his arm, his jaw set. The name drum grinds a black filing into the floor, and the strike plate rings once under no hand.
The strike plate is fogged with steam from the archive, and the old names stand out in the condensation, letter by letter, while the house reads itself back.

The chain well is open, and the rusted chain inside it moves like a throat. The name drum is grinding something out of the registry, and the black aperture above it takes each filing in a slow, oily pulse.

registry_alcove.text: The new registry lies across the signing stone, its pages scorched but ordered. The old names are filed down to rust, and the signing stone holds their marks like a list of hands.
The old names are still legible in the steam, pressed against the registry shelf like wet paper, and the ink well holds a dark smear of blood.

The registry shelf is black with soot, and the name stacks slump into the signing stone. The registry lock stands open, the ink well is dry, and the strike slot has taken a page that is not there yet.

steam_door.text: {C03} stands in the white steam with a burning page in her fist, and the old names come off her lips in a drowned, ordered line.
The white steam is carrying a name toward the door, and the burn rail is warm with the ghost of a hand that is not there.
The steam door is a wall of white heat, and the old archive burns behind it without fire. The burn rail is black, the steam gauge spins past its mark, and the handle is too hot to hold.

crew_gallery.text: {C02} stands at the engine lever with the key sunk into his palm, and the crews' names are filed off the lever's edge.
The engine lever answers to the key with a long, obedient shudder, and the core hooks draw it deeper into the machinery.

The crew gallery shakes with the core's turn, and the core hooks draw the engine lever toward the black aperture. The crew lanterns gutter in oil mist, and the foreman's bell is cracked where it rang too hard.

interactions.text: You draw oil from the spout and run it over the strike plate. The rust beads up, and the chain well answers with a wet, metallic tick.
You strike the cracked foreman's bell, and the sound comes out thin and wrong. The crew lanterns gutter, and no one answers.
You pull a burning page out of the old archive before the steam takes it. The name on it is already gone, and the paper is still warm.
You press your thumb to the signing stone and write the old house name in ink that is already drying. The stone takes it, and the registry lock does not.
The chain settles around your neck, and the gear-throne turns it home. The old order is drowned, the city is still a wound in the earth, and the core does not ask if you are ready.

events.text: The name drum gives a black shudder, and a fresh filing of rust falls into the chain well.
The old archive coughs a page of white steam, and {C03}'s hand comes up empty.

nudges.text: The chain at your neck ticks like a struck clock, waiting for a hand to finish the turn.
The white steam is no longer only steam; it is carrying a name toward you.

recap.text: The core turned the chain around your neck and ground {C01}'s name out of every registry, while {C02} was broken by the machinery that answered to his key and the old archive burned in the white steam. You stood before the gear-throne with the rusted chain on your neck, the old order drowned, the city still a wound in the earth.

opening.text: The transition corridor has folded while you were passing. The floor is a wall now, and the passage lamp burns from the ceiling, throwing the black rail's shadow across the oil stain. The chain at your throat pulls against the lean, and the struck registry page under your thumb is already dark with wet ink. {C01} stands in the lean with a broken hand still wrapped around a brass key. Ahead, steam is eating the seam landing; {C02} waits at the seal wheel, and {C03} is half in the steam, the old banners gone.

leaning_passage.text: {C01} keeps to the handhold plate, his ruined hand still wrapped around the brass key. The registry page stays under his good arm, its struck name smearing wet against his coat. He does not let it fall, though the lean pulls every line of ink toward the oil stain.

{C01} slides against the oil stain, the struck registry page black with wet. He looks at you as if the chain has already chosen. His ruined fingers still hold the brass key, but the grip has gone slack, and the lean has taken his balance.

The tilt gauge in the leaning passage has been turned to {C02}'s mark, and the black rail points toward the seam landing as if it has been permitted. The number on the gauge holds steady, a small official line through the oil stain. The passage lamp throws the rail's shadow straight, as though the lean had been measured and forgiven.

The tilt gauge hangs loose in the leaning passage, its needle swinging where the oil stain has no name. Every drip runs against the lean, and the black rail's shadow skids across the ceiling lamp's light. The passage gives no number for the fall, only a wet sound under the rivets.

The banner remnant in the leaning passage is pinned level by the passage lamp, and {C03}'s old recitation seems to be written in the steam: 'We are not gone. We are only... submerged.' The wet letters do not run; they hold in the steam like names under water, and the lean cannot make them wrong.

The banner remnant is half torn in the leaning passage, and the name on it is smudged into a wet black line. The passage lamp catches only the tear, and the old letters slip through the oil stain like paper under water. No recitation comes from the steam, only a thin wet sound.

The leaning passage is no longer a floor. The title chain runs along the black rail, the passage lamp burns from the ceiling, and the struck registry page flaps against the handhold plate. The oil stain has widened, and every line in the passage leans toward the seam landing. The handhold plate is slick, and the page's struck name runs grey in the wet.

seam_landing.text: {C02} stands at the seal wheel with the engine key against his chest, and his crews hold their rivets in a line that looks like a sentence. The machinery behind him turns in measured intervals, and the oil slick under the seal wheel is kept clean. The seam landing obeys the lean with a small, official patience.

{C02} has the engine key half out of his fist, and the machinery behind him answers with a hungry clank. The seal wheel is slick under his cuffs, and the rivet line of his crews has lost its straightness. The seam landing leans under the lean, and the oil slick runs toward the tide channel.

{C01}'s wet handprint is on the seam door, and he has kept the brass key from the tide. The struck registry page is still under his good arm, its ink dark but legible. The seam landing takes the lean, and the handprint does not smear, as if the door has taken his name.

{C01}'s torn glove lies in the oil slick, and the handprint on the seam door has been dragged sideways. The brass key is gone from his ruined hand, and the struck registry page is black with wet. The seam landing leans over the tide channel, and the oil slick carries the glove toward the seal wheel.

{C03} is half in the steam, but her recitation of the old names is still level, and the registry page she carries is dry. The seam landing takes the lean around her, and the steam does not take her voice. The old names hold in the wet air like rivets in a plate.

{C03} is swallowed by the steam, and the last old name she gives is a wet sound under the core. The seam landing loses the edge of her, and the registry page she carried is gone into the tide. The steam keeps the lean, and the old names do not come back.

The seam landing is half drowned in white steam. The tide channel runs along the rivet handholds, the seal wheel is slick with oil, and the engine key hangs where {C02}'s crews have made it a target. The lean has a number here, and the oil slick keeps it in the rivets.

interactions.text: {C01} tucks the struck page under his good arm. The wet ink smears against his coat, but he follows you down the lean without asking for the chain to do it for him.
The chain jerks his ruined hand and he staggers against the black rail. He keeps the brass key in his ruined fingers, and the registry page slips down his sleeve with a wet sound.
interactions.detail_label: pull him by the chain toward the engine

interactions.text: You wrench the brass key free. It leaves a black smear on your fist, and {C01}'s ruined hand opens with a small, human sound.
interactions.detail_label: take the brass key from his ruined hand

interactions.text: He nods and does not let go of the brass key. The chain creaks, but he follows you toward the seam landing with the registry page wet against his coat.
{C02} presses the engine key harder against his chest. The core turns less sharply behind the steam, as if the machine has been asked.
interactions.detail_label: 'Keep it. Let the core turn as it will.'

interactions.text: The machinery seizes his arm first, and the engine key is torn hot into your palm. The core's turn answers in your wrist.
interactions.detail_label: take the engine key from his hand

interactions.text: {C02} calls it a release, and his crews lower their rivets. The steam behind {C03} does not thin, but the drowning is already permitted.
{C02} steps aside from the seal wheel. His crews do not lower their rivets, but they make a narrow path through the steam.
The seam door swings on a black rail, and the seam landing takes the lean with you. {C02}'s crews do not stop the tilt; they only make room for it.
You go back up the lean, where the floor is a wall and the passage lamp burns on the ceiling. The tide channel keeps its own time behind you.
You go out the engine gates, where the steam tide is already carrying the first of the old city's banners into the dark. The next scene takes you by the tide channel's edge.
You trim the passage lamp with a blackened thumb. The flame steadies on the ceiling, and the shadows stop running for a breath.
You set the tilt gauge to the lean. It does not make the floor a floor; it only gives the passage a number for how much it has betrayed you.
The seal wheel grinds under the oil slick. A seam in the engine gates closes a hand's width, and the steam loses one of its voices.
You work the rivet handholds along the tide channel. They hold, but the seam landing still leans a little further into the dark.

events.text: The seam door shudders; a second wave of steam lifts the banner remnant and drags it into the dark.

nudges.text: The title chain creaks, and somewhere the seam door answers with a cold clank.
{C01}'s broken hand twitches in the dark, and the brass key gives a small ring.

recap.text: The corridor lurches and the floor becomes a wall. You grip the chain as the seam drags you sideways; {C01} holds your hand, his body torn along the ceiling. The chain bites his glove and breaks his hand. The registry page under your thumb shows his name struck, yet he follows you down with the brass key in his ruined hand as steam carries the last banners into the dark.

opening.text: The engine gates stand open on a throat of white steam. Below, the core turns louder than it has turned in living memory. {C02} waits at the gate channels, the brass key in his ruined hand, the new registry open on his arm. Behind him, {C03}'s drowned mouth moves in the steam. {C05} and his steam crews have stopped at the core threshold, their eyes sliding over your hands where the old seal has split under the wet.

gate_antechamber.text: Your ruined hand grips the registry strap, and the brass key is in yours, not {C02}'s. The gate hooks are slick with oil, and the registry lectern creaks as it tries to keep the pages from flying.

Your ruined hand hangs empty over the gate hooks, and the brass key is still in {C02}'s fist. The crew bench is wet where someone sat, and the foreman's token glints on the lectern like a small, patient wound.

Steam has pooled on the floor of the gate antechamber, running along the seams in thin silver lines. The new registry lies open on the lectern, its pages lifting and settling with every turn of the core.

lower_doors.text: {C03} stands where the steam thins, her drowned mouth moving without sound until the tide lock shudders. The archive mouth behind her is half open, and the old names hang in the air like wet ash.
{C03} has gone quiet behind the steam, her hands flat against the lower doors as if she is holding them shut. The archive mouth is dark, and the seal plate is furred with condensation.
The lower doors are sweating, the chain rail slick under the steam, and the tide lock is clicking softly as if it is counting something it has forgotten how to keep.

core_threshold.text: {C02}'s broken arm is still holding the key, white-knuckled and shaking, and his men press closer to you as the machinery answers. The gear throat is open, and the core gauge is climbing past the red line.

{C02}'s broken arm is empty, the key gone from his fist, and his men step back from you as if the old seal on your hands has already spoken. The gear plate is fouled with oil, and the core ledge is trembling under the turn of the core.

The core threshold is a mouth of heat and moving iron. The gate channels are full of steam, the gear throat is groaning, and the core gauge is swinging as if the machine is deciding what to take next.

interactions.text: {C03}'s voice steadies inside the steam, and the dead names come out one by one, low and wet. The registry pages stop buckling as the steam passes over them, and the core turns a little less hungry.
You strike a name from the registry, and the ink blots under your thumb. The steam thickens, and {C03}'s whisper drops to the size of a cough, but the core keeps turning.
interactions.detail_label: strike a name from the new registry

interactions.text: You brace the lower doors with {C03}. The steam takes her shoulder, and the door slams half shut. The core answers, and the gate channels fill with white.
You step back from the lower doors and let the steam take its time. {C03}'s mouth keeps moving, and the core waits, patient as a mouth full of teeth.
interactions.detail_label: 'Later. Let the steam do its work.'

interactions.text: {C05} takes the new registry and opens it on his shoulder, and his men stand straighter as the oil-stamped letters fill the pages. The old ink seems to shrink back into the paper, as if it has been told to wait.
{C05}'s jaw tightens, and his men look at the old registry in your other hand as if it is a wound. The new registry stays open on his shoulder, but the letters do not move.
You put the steam crews to the gear throat. One man slips, and the core catches his sleeve. The engine keeps turning, and the gate channels fill with the sound of iron deciding.
interactions.detail_label: make the crews hold the core open

interactions.text: {C05} does not answer, but his men hold where they stand. The core turns, and the old seal on your hands stays broken in the steam.
interactions.detail_label: 'Hold where you stand. Let the core turn.'

interactions.text: You take the brass key from {C02}'s hand, and the machinery answers with a crack that runs up his broken arm. His men look at you, and the key is warm against your palm.
You wipe the core gauge clear with your sleeve, and the needle is already past the red line. The glass is warm, and the steam leaves a thin film over the numbers.
You ease the chain on the tide lock, and the lower doors shudder but do not close. The chain rail is slick, and the archive mouth behind them smells of wet paper and old names.

You take the foreman's token from the lectern, and it is heavier than it looks. The brass is worn smooth where other hands have held it, and the old seal on your fingers leaves a faint print in the metal.
You pass {C02}'s broken arm and {C05}'s waiting crews, the key and registry in your hands. {C05} says, 'The core won't wait for a new name. Feed it a hand.' The lower doors open onto the next dark.

nudges.text: The core turns louder, and the steam in the gate antechamber begins to press against your ears like a hand.
{C03}'s voice comes through the steam again, lower this time, as if the dead names are trying to find a way back into the registry.

recap.text: At the engine gates, {C02} held the engine key and the new registry while the core turned louder, and {C03} whispered the dead names in the steam behind him. The machinery broke {C02}'s arm, and {C05} made his men look at your hands, where the old order's last seal lay split.

opening.text: Below the throne the core slows, and the dark aperture opens wider with every pass. White steam breathes through the cracks, wet wool, oil, and hot mineral breath fill the gallery. {C01} is at the steam door with his broken hand on the brass key. {C02} waits before the engine lock in the gear-throne. {C05} stands in the crew gallery, his crews hanging on the rails. The old names are wet somewhere in the registry alcove. The whole city smells of oil and burned paper. The lock waits for a hand that is not yours.

gear_throne.text: When the core stops, the registry in your hand is still legible, and {C03}'s voice comes behind you, naming the old line as if it had never been spent.
When the core stops, the registry in your hand is already soft with steam, and {C03}'s voice is gone, leaving only the wet blur of the names.
When the core stops, {C05}'s men are braced against the gears, and the registry lies open under their names, ink drying in the cold of the machine.
When the core stops, {C05}'s men are pulling their hands from the steam, and the registry opens under their names as if the water had already signed for them.
The gear-throne stands at the center of the cut, its dark aperture waiting like a mouth that has been told to open.

interactions.text: You take the chain and keep it from jerking. {C01} stays with the door, and the key turns in the lock. The steam waits for a slip.
You speak {C01}'s name before the core strikes it. The name comes back for one breath, and the steam door holds a little longer under {C01}'s ruined hand.
You haul {C01} back by the chain. He comes away from the door, the key drops, and the steam floods the gap behind him.
You say only enough to keep {C01} where he is. The chain rests loose in your hand, and the door does not yet choose for him.
You hand {C02} the wet pages. He crosses out a line of ink, and the core settles.
You press the wet pages against the lock around the engine key. {C02}'s face closes as the machinery resists him, and the old order will not fit the new throat.
interactions.detail_label: press the old registry against the lock

interactions.text: You accept {C02}'s apology for the steam. He calls the drowning a release, and the gear-throne answers with a softer grind.
interactions.detail_label: 'The steam was no fault of yours.'

interactions.text: You turn the engine key in the lock. The gear-throne takes the turn without softening or grinding harder, and the choice is not yet yours to make.
interactions.detail_label: turn the engine key in the lock

interactions.text: You tip oil into the spout and watch it run black down the teeth of the throne. The machine takes the oil the way a cut takes water.
You strike the bell once. {C05}'s men tighten on the core hooks, and the gallery creaks under the weight of the turning dark.
You set the names in the new registry. The ink dries fast in the heat of the machine, and each name looks already spent.
You step past the chain well toward the dark aperture. {C05}'s bell sounds once, and the core takes you under its turning dark.

events.text: The great gear-throne stops in perfect silence, showing the city as a ragged cut in the rock, then starts again, and the rotating gears open a dark throat around the throne.

nudges.text: The core gives a lurch, and the chain at {C01}'s wrist pulls hard enough to make the steam door sing.
{C02}'s broken arm rests on the gear-throne, and the engine key waits in the lock like a question.

recap.text: The gear-throne stopped, showed the city as a ragged cut in the rock, and started again while {C05}'s men held the core open and the new registry took their names. {C01}'s brass key held the steam door open with his broken hand, the core ground his name out of every registry, and the black signet drew the rusted chain around your neck.

opening.text: You stand before the gear-throne as it finishes its turning. {C02} is ground into its teeth, the old archive is burning in white steam, and {C03}'s voice is gone from the lower levels. The crew gallery is empty where {C05}'s bell used to ring. {C01} is still where the steam left him, his broken hand near the door, the brass key in it or gone from it. The chain around your neck holds the crown's place, and the dark wound below the city waits for the title to turn.

gear_throne.text: {C02}'s engine key is still hot in the chain's teeth. The gear-throne has not let go of his conviction, and the strike plate rings with it.
{C02} is only a gear now. The strike plate has ground his name to filings, and the engine key in the chain well is cold.
{C01} stands at the door of the gear-throne, his broken hand on the brass key, and the house name still rides in his voice.
{C01} stands beside you, his broken hand empty, only a body holding the door.

registry_alcove.text: The old registry lies open on the signing stone, its pages still holding the names. The name stacks are wet but legible, and the ink well is full of struck witness.
The old registry is half burned in the white steam. The name stacks curl into the ink well, and no name comes out of them.

steam_door.text: The white steam carries {C03}'s recitation like a struck witness: the old names ride in it, wet and legible, against the burn rail.
The white steam has swallowed {C03}'s recitation whole. The old archive is only black pulp, and the steam gauge is dead.

crew_gallery.text: The crew gallery is empty except for the core hooks, still swinging. The foreman's bell has stopped mid-ring, and the oil drum is cracked open.

interactions.text: You draw oil from the spout and run it over the strike plate. The filings from {C02}'s name slide away, and the plate is clean enough for one more turn.
You take a wet name token from the stacks. It is warm, and the ink on it is still trying to hold a shape.
You ring the foreman's bell once. The core hooks swing in answer, and the crew lanterns gutter out one by one.
You step into the black aperture with the chain around your neck. The gear-throne takes the title, and the machine's name turns on in the dark wound of the city.

events.text: The name drum ticks out a syllable that is not any name in the registry.

nudges.text: The chain tightens enough to make you remember you are still holding the title.

recap.text: The engine swallowed {C05} and his crew, ground {C02} into the throne, burned the archive in white steam, and left {C03}'s voice gone from the lower levels; you stood before the gear-throne, chain at your neck, {C01} broken and unregistered beside you, while the title turned as the machine's name in the dark wound of the city.

opening.text: You stand in the gate antechamber as the core's turning swells into a lower, grinding roar. White steam breathes through the cracks at the lower doors, wet wool and gear oil filling the air. The old registry steams against your wrist, and {C01}'s brass key is warm in your fist. {C02} waits at the registry lectern, the engine key held above the crews' names, the new registry dry in his other hand. At the lower doors, {C03} is already thin in the steam, her wet fingers holding a page flat against the tide. The old seal waits to be broken, and the name in the page begins to loosen.

gate_antechamber.text: At the lectern, {C02} stands straighter, the engine key held like a verdict above the crews' names.
{C02}'s hand trembles over the crews' names, the engine key catching white light as if it might fall.
The new registry lies open on the lectern, the ink still wet, and the gate hooks drip into the drain.

lower_doors.text: {C01} keeps his hand on the brass key, the title's chain taut from his wrist toward the engine gate.
{C01}'s wrist is slack where the chain runs, the brass key warm and useless in his fist.
The lower doors are already closing under the steam, and the seal plate steams where the old seal broke.

core_threshold.text: {C03}'s whisper is clear enough to hold the page flat against the steam.
{C03}'s voice is a wet thread in the steam, barely more than the page's own hiss.
The gate channels drink the steam, and the core gauge swings as the gear throat opens wider.

interactions.text: {C02} signs the new registry without looking up. The steam answers his hand, and the crews' names begin to blur under the engine order.
You wrench for the key. {C02}'s cuff catches your wrist, the key bites your palm, and he signs the new registry.
{C02}'s hand does not drop. The key stays above the names, and the wet old registry waits in your fist.
You keep the chain taut without pulling. {C01} grips the brass key and steps back from the steam, his name still in his throat.
{C01} stumbles into the steam. The key clatters against the gate's rim, and the lower doors take the sound with them.
interactions.detail_label: by the chain: pull him toward the gate

interactions.text: {C01} does not answer. The chain creaks in the rail, and the steam waits for his fist.
{C03}'s whisper finishes the struck name once. The old ink darkens for a breath, then begins to lift in the steam.
The page seals with a wet crack. {C03}'s voice thins to nothing, and the struck name stays under the ink.
You keep the page flat with your thumb. The steam lifts around the ink, and {C03}'s voice waits for the name to leave her throat.
interactions.detail_label: the page open: keep it flat

interactions.text: The fresh ink is still wet. Under the engine order, the struck name is listed as ballast, and the old house reads like a weight being measured.
The hooks are slick with condensation. Your coat drips into the drain, and the antechamber smells of wet wool and gear oil.
interactions.detail_label: hang your coat on the gate hooks

interactions.text: It is cold and stamped with the engine's gear-tooth. Whoever wore it trusted the crew more than the registry.
The bench is wet, but the old registry lies flat against it. The steam at your wrist slows, as if the page has been given a place to rest.
The steam takes the passage. Behind you the lower doors seal, and the core threshold opens under white water.

nudges.text: The core's turn grows louder, and the steam begins to read the registry for you.
{C03}'s wet whisper thins in the steam, waiting for a name that will not stay still.

recap.text: You stood at the engine gates while {C02} held the engine key and the new registry, the core turning louder and the steam rising. The brass key was given to him; {C03}'s wet whisper recited the servant's name as he struck it, broke the old seal, and the steam closed the lower doors behind {C01}, key in hand, name gone.

opening.text: The gear-throne waits at the heart of the city, its rim half-turned and the black aperture still closed. {C02} stands at the core with the new registry, {C01} is braced against the chain well, {C03} holds the steam door, and {C05} watches from the crew gallery. The old archive steams white behind the door, and the name drum is turning your name toward the strike plate.

gear_throne.text: {C02} stands at the core with the engine key in his hand and the new registry dry against his coat.
{C02}'s grip is missing the key; he wipes steam from the page and stands a step back from the rim.
{C01}'s chain hangs where he braced, his hand still open around the key.
{C01}'s chain is slack, and the key is gone from his fist.
The name drum turns under the strike plate, and the chain well smells of iron and old water.

registry_alcove.text: {C03}'s handprint is still wet on the registry, the name legible for one more second.
The page is blank where the steam has already swallowed it, and the ink well is dry as bone.
The name stacks lean over the signing stone, and the strike slot is black with old cuts.

steam_door.text: {C03}'s cold hand is on the steam door, and the white surge stops at her fingers.
{C03}'s handprint steams off the door, and the white surge is running into the old archive.
The steam gauge ticks against the burn rail, and the old archive is white beyond the glass.

crew_gallery.text: {C05} keeps the hold bar braced, as if {C02}'s key still holds the city's weight.
{C05} has let the hold bar sag, and the core hooks are slipping in the oil.
The crew lanterns drip oil, and the foreman's bell hangs still above the gallery.

interactions.text: {C02} straightens under your words, and the crews' hooks bite a little harder in the rim. The new registry turns another notch under his key. The white steam keeps its place, for now.

The rim catches {C02}'s sleeve as the core shifts, and he stumbles back into the white steam. His key slips, and the new registry skids against the strike plate. He is broken enough to sign, and the rim keeps him there.
{C05} takes the hold bar and lets the core's own weight decide. {C02} neither straightens nor breaks, and the registry keeps turning under his key.
The name leaves your mouth once, and the chain at your neck loosens for a breath. {C01}'s hand twitches where the chain holds him. The strike plate waits, but the ink does not dry.
{C02}'s key cuts the ink, and the name is gone from the registry. The last ballast drops, and the core takes the weight without complaint. {C01}'s chain goes slack.
You keep the name drum turning, and the strike plate waits for a hand that is not yours. The registry stays wet, and the core does not choose for you.
{C03}'s cold hand stays on the steam door, and the white surge stops at her fingers. The archive stays dry for one more breath. Her voice does not come back, but the steam does not take it yet.
The steam takes {C03}'s hand, and the archive goes white behind her. The old names rise in the vapor like smoke from a drowned house. The door is no longer a door.
interactions.detail_label: open the steam door to the white steam

interactions.text: The steam gauge ticks against the burn rail, and the white surge holds where it is. {C03}'s hand does not move, and the archive does not decide.
The oil runs black over the chain well and the rusted links move a little easier. The core drinks it without thanks. Your hands smell of iron and old water.
The bell rings once through the crew gallery, and the steam crews tighten their hold on the core hooks. {C05} does not look at you, but the gallery steadies under the sound.
You wipe the wet ink from the registry shelf, and the old names blur into one another. The signing stone stays dry under your hand. The strike slot is still black with old cuts.
You leave the stopped core behind, and the black aperture closes over the throne like a seam sealing. The next level opens ahead, lower and louder, and the city's weight follows you down.

events.text: The gear-throne stops for a breath of perfect silence, and the city below shows itself as a wound in the earth; then it starts again, and the black hole of rotating gears opens around the throne.

nudges.text: {C02}'s voice carries from the core: 'The registry is turning. Say which name holds.'

recap.text: The gear-throne stopped, showed the city as a wound, then started, opening a black hole of gears. The brass key held the steam door and the last name was struck, drawing the rusted chain around your neck as {C02} stood whole with the engine key and new registry, {C05} and the steam crews held the core open, {C01} was ground out, and {C03}'s voice spent in white steam.

opening.text: You stand at the rim of the gear-throne as the core finishes its turn. The chain at your neck has stopped being a title; it is a rusted weight that names the ruin. {C02} is at the core, holding the engine key and the new registry. In the registry alcove, {C01} is being cut from the old registry, the ink lifting from the page. At the steam door, {C03} watches the archive go white behind her. The lower doors close under a tide of steam, and the city groans beneath the machine.

gear_throne.text: {C02} stands whole at the core, the engine key in one hand and the new registry dry in the other. The old registry is losing its edges, but the new page keeps its line.
{C02}'s sleeve is torn, and the new registry steams in his hand like something pulled from a wet grave. The engine key is still in his fingers, but the registry is not dry.

The gear-throne turns under a seal of white steam. The chain well takes the light, the black aperture opens wider than a mouth that has forgotten swallowing, and the name drum waits with the strike plate under your hand.

registry_alcove.text: {C01}'s name is still legible on the old registry, the ink sharp under the registry lock, and the page holds the line where a cut has not yet been made.
The ink is cut, and the page is blank where {C01}'s name was, the cut clean as a knife through a throat.
The registry shelf keeps the name stacks under a breath of steam. The signing stone is cold, the ink well is half full, and the strike slot is open to the dark.

steam_door.text: {C03}'s handprint is still on the steam door, and the archive behind it is dry enough to hold a name. The wet edge stops at the frame, as if the water has not yet learned the room.
The door is gone to white steam, and the archive behind it is no longer a room but a moving white. {C03}'s voice is spent in it.
The steam door seals the old archive behind white. The steam gauge stands past the mark, the burn rail is black with old heat, and the handle is too hot to promise.

crew_gallery.text: The crew gallery runs along the core hooks. The hold bar is slick with oil, the foreman's bell is dark, the crew lanterns are low, the oil drum breathes, and the engine lever is ready to throw the city's weight.

interactions.text: The lower doors groan shut behind you. The steam tide takes the gallery, the alcove, and the throne, and the city's wound keeps turning under the machine.
The oil beads black down the links, and the chain runs easier. The name it carries is still yours, and the metal drinks the shine without keeping it.
The drum gives one dull note, and every name in the city answers half a beat late. The strike plate rings the ruin's name back at you, plain and unlovely, and the note stays in the iron.
{C02} does not look at the key. 'The old names,' he says. 'Ballast. The engine required weight. The registry required a line to stop.'
The lock turns with a sound like a bone giving. The name stacks shift, and the ink on the last page is already drying into a blank.
The needle sits in the white, past the safe mark. Behind the door the old archive is no longer paper; it is pressure, and the pressure is patient.
You get the hold bar under your hands and the gallery drops away under a film of oil. From up here the gear-throne is only a turning eye, and the chain at your neck is a spoke.
The drum breathes out a black breath and the crew lanterns gutter. The engine lever shines under the new oil, and the lower doors sound farther away.

events.text: The black aperture takes a lantern's worth of light, and the gear-throne's turn goes one notch deeper into the earth.

nudges.text: {C02}'s voice carries from the core, thin over the steam: 'The chain is waiting. The name is not.'
The chain at your neck pulls once, as if the ruin has remembered your weight.

recap.text: The core turned the chain around your neck, reclaiming the title only as a rusted burden that named the ruin, while {C02} stood at the core with the engine key and the new registry and the old archive drowned in white steam. {C01} was gone from every registry, {C03} was gone from the lower levels, and the city remained a wound in the earth beneath the turning machine.

text.text: You reach the gear-throne. You take the title back. It comes back as a rusted chain that names the dead instead of a living house. {C01} is dead at the foot of the throne, his hands closed around the chain so you could reach it. {C02} is broken by the machinery he served, his body caught where the engine order ended. The city remains a wound in the earth. White steam moves through the throne room. The chain rests on your neck, and the dead names move under the rust. The old order does not save it. The engine does not fully own it.

The gear-throne grinds {C02} to iron and swallows the crews. {C01} stands with his broken hand. The chain draws around your neck as the machine's name. {C03} is gone from the steam. The old archive burns. The title is reclaimed only as a rusted burden that names the engine's ruin.

The old order is struck out before the throne turns.
